sources.entry: Tintpad - Menu bar launcher that opens your terminal at the right repo with a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) already running. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sorkila/tintpad) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Tintpad - Hotkey launcher that opens your terminal at the right repo with a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) already running.

summary.one_liner: Tintpad is a free, open source macOS menu bar launcher that opens your terminal at a chosen repo with a coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex already running.
summary.what_it_does: It shows a drop-down panel summoned by a hotkey (default ⌥⌘Space) that lists your repos; you type a few letters and press Return to open your terminal at that repo with the configured agent command running. Two chips on the panel show exactly what Return will run, and a mode that skips permissions is shown in red and can ask for confirmation. It supports a set of terminals (Ghostty, iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, Terminal, Warp), with Warp receiving the repo and the command copied to the clipboard instead. Agents are configured as command templates with variables like {repoPath}, {prompt} and {mode}, with values shell-quoted before running. Extra features include frecency-ranked repos, git worktree creation, headless background dispatch with notification, continue-last-conversation shortcuts, a prompt library, per-repo presets, GitHub import and open-in-editor.
use_cases: launch Claude Code in a project quickly
open a terminal at a git repo with an AI coding agent
run a coding agent in a background worktree
switch between multiple code repositories from the keyboard
resume the last Claude Code or Codex conversation
how_to_run: Or download Tintpad.dmg (signed and notarized, macOS 14+)
notable: Launches your existing terminal rather than opening a new one, with the agent already running at the repo
Shows the exact command Return will run in the panel before it fires
Reads the login shell PATH once so GUI-launched apps can find CLIs like claude
Git worktree support with ⌃W and background headless dispatch with ⌃⏎
Local-only with no account or telemetry
caveats: You must install the agent CLI yourself (claude, codex or another); Tintpad does not bundle one
Accessibility and other macOS permissions may be needed, and a stale grant may require removing and re-adding the app
Warp has no command API, so it only opens the repo and copies the command to the clipboard
